mutations.reason: Accepts a region access through any base register, whatever is known of the index (J.6: an index register compared against the region's bound): a load through an index no bounds check touched would be accepted, so lemma_region_access_facts is false.

Reverses the comparison of the checked size and the access size, so a check for 4 bytes would license an 8-byte access and the last 4 bytes could lie outside the region: lemma_region_access_facts is false.

Does not compare the region of the base register with the region the index was checked against, so an index checked against a small region could be used with a large region's base: lemma_region_access_facts is false.

Lets the code write the stack pointer (J.6: reserved registers and the stack pointer are written only in the fixed prologue and epilogue), which would make the exit sequence's ret return anywhere: lemma_plain_ok_safe is false.

Drops the rule that every direct target is the start of a unit (J.6: every direct target is a decoded boundary inside the blob). Verus fails on example_jump_into_check_rejected (a jump into the middle of a bounds check would be accepted), but that example is evaluated with compute_only, which cannot be a certificate (see the header of lemmas.rs), and no general lemma states the rule yet.
